note: Which local file the 3D preview plays for each sound id (web-owned; the editor's server reads it, never writes it). Rule: the file Unreal plays TODAY at that moment, verified on 2026-10-05 against the Blueprint trackers (.claude/skills/unreal-vr/blueprints), the sound assets each Blueprint names, and the import source + MD5 stored in each SoundWave .uasset; or the placeholder imported under the sound id's own name. A path is relative to the media root (Recursos/Soul Charger - Escritorio 2026-10/Audio or VVR_MEDIA), or starts with 'unreal:' (VR_Test/) or 'recursos:' (Recursos/); a path that leaves its root, a missing file or a VO_ id is skipped (voices keep their name matching). A file never changes a time of the score: the 3D plays it at its clip's time, to its own end (ambiences loop until the next one). 'gain' = the volume Unreal plays it at (0-1), applied to the preview only.
